# Step - as_vector

`as_vector` · category: [Vectors](../../traversal/step_reference.md#vectors)

Converts a list of numbers to an f32 vector; a vector passes (see the book page Vectors).

## Forms

```text
as_vector()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject([0.5, 1]).as_vector().next()   // vector([0.5, 1.0])
```
